headword: {入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ}

definitions.gloss: immigration inspection; passport control; immigration check
definitions.explanation: The process of checking passports, visas, and entry qualifications at a country's border or airport. An essential procedure when entering any country.

examples.japanese: {入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ}に{並|なら}ぶ。
examples.english: To line up for immigration inspection.

examples.japanese: {入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ}でパスポートを{見|み}せてください。
examples.english: Please show your passport at immigration.

examples.japanese: {連休|れんきゅう}の{時期|じき}は{空港|くうこう}の{入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ}が{混|こ}み{合|あ}うので、{時間|じかん}に{余裕|よゆう}を{持|も}ったほうがいい。
examples.english: During holiday periods, immigration at the airport gets crowded, so it's better to allow extra time.

notes:
Composed of {入国|にゅうこく} (entering a country) + {審査|しんさ} (examination, screening). An essential travel word that every international traveler encounters. At Japanese airports, signs are typically bilingual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ}を{受|う}ける — to go through immigration
- {入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ}{官|かん} — immigration officer
- {入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ}カウンター — immigration counter
- {自動|じどう}{入国審査|にゅうこくしんさ} — automated immigration (e-gates)

RELATED WORDS:
- {出国審査|しゅっこくしんさ} — departure/emigration inspection
- {税関|ぜいかん} — customs
- {検疫|けんえき} — quarantine
- {入国|にゅうこく}カード — arrival card, disembarkation card
